title: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Donnelley Financial Solutions (DFIN) filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026 disclosing that its Board authorized a new share repurchase program of up to $150 million of common stock, replacing a prior program that had approximately $15 million remaining. The new program is effective April 17, 2026 through December 31, 2027.
key_points: DFIN's Board authorized share repurchases of up to $150 million on April 16, 2026
The new program replaces a prior $150 million program with approximately $15 million still remaining
Repurchases may occur on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions
The program may be executed under a Rule 10b5-1 plan to permit repurchases during blackout periods
The program is effective through December 31, 2027
DFIN trades on NYSE under symbol DFIN
